## Historical audit — S0255

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_4/audit_sources/raw_failures/scene_rsi_v2_1/r1/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_80372956/trajectory.jsonl`. All references below are to this file; each cited observation is complete, not split.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1, chars [0,5604) | Goal: reconstruct one RGB indoor photograph with separate meshes and a matching camera, without using the image as a texture or accessing other views. The image itself is not visible in this audit. |
| Student `model_response`, line 3, chars [0,7994); `execute`, line 4, chars [0,8625) | The student produced and submitted a nonempty program. Its interpretation of the scene was a painted pitched ceiling, timber framing and a radial brass chandelier—not independently verified image content. It constructs numerous separate components, including beams, ceiling panels, a globe, suspension, arms and cups. |
| Same response and execution | The code assigns colors and metallic/roughness values; board joints are modeled geometrically, but no texture map or procedural texture is evident. It positions a suspension between chandelier and ceiling and arms near the globe, but actual connectivity and intersections were not verified. The intended fixture pose is radial and suspended. |
| Same response and execution | The program sets an upward-looking 28 mm camera, three area lights, world illumination, Cycles at 64 samples and 512 × 341 resolution. These are settings, not evidence of a correct camera, lighting or render. |
| `codex_session`, line 2, chars [0,2840); `execution_result`, line 5, chars [0,1063) | One student response and one execution are visible. The CLI session reports zero tool calls; Blender execution timed out after about 516 seconds with empty stdout/stderr and `image: null`. No rendered inspection or correction is visible. |

**Teacher and exploration.** No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution of an update, or student adoption is present in this trace. The student autonomously authored and submitted one scene program; no iterative exploration is visible. Availability of a reference image in the request does not make its pixels available to this audit.

**Outcome and uncertainty.** This is a **technical interruption** with an unknown reconstruction outcome, not a demonstrated geometric failure or formal success. The timeout does not establish whether scene construction, rendering, or another stage consumed the time. No successful build, render, score, visual comparison, or `DONE` appears. Multiple modeled objects and intended part connections are evidenced by code, but their appearance, pose, material fidelity, occlusions, camera framing and actual attachment remain unverified.

**Lessons and hypotheses.** Transferably, separate the submitted scene description from successful execution and visual validation; a complex build can leave no inspectable result when the runner times out. Task-specific hypotheses—that geometry count, Cycles settings, or another operation caused the timeout, and that the ceiling/chandelier interpretation matches the photograph—remain unresolved.
